title: prompt-mode updates, page-side kill switch, persistent storage and 426
context: Tasks 1-36 are done on socle once socle-pwa is merged: the custom SW (T36: SKIP_WAITING, GET_STATUS with localDbVersion and illustrationsReferenced, SYNC_ILLUSTRATIONS, SW-side kill switch, local-DB marker cache), cache constants in sw/precache-manifest.ts (T35; manifest without orientation lock since 823a3a8), sw-client getSwStatus/postToSw, StatusRepo (activeSessionId, illustrationFiles, requestPersistentStorage writing meta.persistGranted), AppShell/PublicShell (the onboarding renders in PublicShell), CreateAccountForm (T30) and ReadyStep emitting ONBOARDING_COMPLETED_EVENT (T31). main.tsx registers no service worker yet: this task adds the whole page side.
rulings:
- Spec is the binding authority over the brief. Straight apostrophe ' in all UI copy. Screens never touch Dexie (only repos); never use navigator.onLine.
- Exact UI contract used by T39's E2E: UpdateBanner renders nothing when show is false; otherwise a root with data-testid="update-banner" and data-dismissible="true|false", the text « Nouvelle version disponible », buttons « Mettre à jour » and « Plus tard » (the latter only when dismissible); forced: no « Plus tard » and the sentence « Mets à jour l'appli pour reprendre la synchronisation. ». AppShell renders <UpdateBanner /> first; PublicShell (onboarding, public pages) has none.
- shouldShowUpdateBanner: show = available && activeSessionId === null && !onboardingInProgress; dismissible = !forced (the brief's 8-row table). UpdateBanner: onboardingInProgress = me !== null && me.onboardingCompletedAt === null; activeSessionId from useLive(() => repos.status.activeSessionId(), []); the local dismissed state is ignored once forced (R-PWA-3, R-PWA-5).
- available needs a waiting worker, a controller, and the WAITING worker's own GET_STATUS answer (MessageChannel, 1 s) with localDbVersion >= LOCAL_DB_VERSION (R-PWA-9, ADR 0001 decision 5). A silent waiting SW or a lower version is never offered and never gets SKIP_WAITING (R-DEP-4 image-only rollback). First install (no controller) → available false.
- Update checks (R-PWA-2): register('/sw.js', { scope: '/', updateViaCache: 'none' }), registration.update() at launch, when the page becomes visible again, and every 3 600 000 ms only while visible.
- applyUpdate (R-PWA-4): sets a reloading flag, posts exactly one { type: 'SKIP_WAITING' } to the waiting worker, reloads only on controllerchange while the flag is set, once even if the event repeats; controllerchange without applyUpdate never reloads; with meta.activeSessionId set it sends nothing (R-PWA-3).
- 426 (R-VER-2, R-PWA-5): SyncState connection 'protocol_unsupported' → markForced() and a new update check; the outbox is untouched. No service worker support → inert controller { available: false, forced: false }.
- bootServiceWorker: production only (import.meta.env.PROD), started with void so it never delays the first render. Health probe through fetchWithTimeout (T26), JSON read even on a 503 (T9 ruling: degraded health keeps swKill). swKill true → applyKillSwitchIfNeeded and stop WITHOUT registering (swControllerStore stays null); probe null or swKill false → register and publish the controller; then post SYNC_ILLUSTRATIONS with status.illustrationFiles() when a controller exists, and again on every controllerchange (R-SYN-32; T36 counts illustrations against the last list received, so a dropped post keeps « Prêt hors ligne » red).
- Carry (ledger 2026-10-08, ADR 0001 decision 5, T35-F1 and T36 reports): after Dexie opens, the page raises the local-DB marker: Cache Storage LOCAL_DB_MARKER_CACHE ('appsport-meta'), key LOCAL_DB_MARKER_KEY ('/__sw/local-db-version'), synthetic Response whose body is max(current marker, LOCAL_DB_VERSION); never lowered; constants imported from sw/precache-manifest.ts (never from sw.ts, so the page never bundles SW code); a write failure never blocks boot. Not in the brief's file list: put it in register.ts (called by bootServiceWorker) and test it with createFakeCacheStorage, which now takes an options object { origin?, failPut?, failDelete? } (T36).
- Page kill switch (R-PWA-6): unregister every registration, delete the caches named shell-* and illustrations-* (by prefix, as T36 does), keep 'appsport-meta' and any other cache (the brief's expected ['autre'] becomes ['appsport-meta','autre'] when the marker is seeded), never touch indexedDB (meta.userId intact); reload once and only if something was unregistered or deleted — nothing to clean → false, no reload (the T36 SW-side switch may already have cleaned up and navigated).
- Persistent storage (R-SYN-31, R-CPT-2, ledger « Carry to T37 »): installPersistOnOnboarding(repos.status) in main.tsx listens to ONBOARDING_COMPLETED_EVENT (dispatched by ReadyStep) and calls requestPersistentStorage only if isStandalone() (features/auth/install-help.ts); the returned function removes the listener. CreateAccountForm on success and isStandalone() → void repos.status.requestPersistentStorage(); no direct call in ReadyStep (the event covers it). StatusRepo writes meta.persistGranted (T38 asserts it is a boolean in installed mode; SettingsPage displays it).
- Known deferred minors (ledger 2026-10-08), not for this task: kill-switch reload vs the older-schema guarantee (ADR, R-PWA-6), illustration list after a failed write, same-size catalog update window.
- Tests: apps/web/test/sw/{update-banner-rules,register,kill-switch}.test.ts and {UpdateBanner,persist}.test.tsx with test/support/fake-sw-container.ts; RED = « Failed to resolve import "../../src/sw/register" »; GREEN = Test Files 5 passed, then the whole web suite (architecture.test included), pnpm lint, pnpm typecheck.
- OWNER RULING (2026-10-08), ADR 0001 decision 7 confirmed: a full close of the app counts as consent to activate a newer waiting build; while any app window is open nothing activates without the « Mettre à jour » click; an older-schema build never reaches waiting (decision 5).
- Reports never contain codes, links with a fragment, passwords or tokens.
risks: (a) Reload loops or double reloads: a controllerchange caused by T36's clients.claim on first install must not reload; the page kill switch must not reload when the SW-side switch already cleaned up, nor register a SW when swKill is true. (b) A waiting SW with a lower localDbVersion, or one that never answers GET_STATUS within 1 s, gets offered or activated — GET_STATUS must go to registration.waiting, not to the controller (R-PWA-9, R-DEP-4). (c) bootServiceWorker delaying the first render, running in dev or in tests, or treating a 503 health body as « no answer » (kill switch lost during an outage). (d) SYNC_ILLUSTRATIONS not re-posted when a controller appears or changes, leaving readiness red. (e) Banner rules: visible during onboarding or with activeSessionId set, still closable after a 426, or a « Plus tard » dismissal surviving a later 426. (f) main.tsx has no Repos today (useRepos caches one set per AppServices in a WeakMap): wiring repos.status there must not create a second divergent repos set; persist never requested in a browser tab, nor twice for one event.
parallelOk: Can run alongside T41 and T42 (apps/server build, infra/, .github: disjoint files). Not alongside T38/T39 (they consume its banner and bootServiceWorker and edit apps/web).

title: Playwright E2E harness, arrival and offline (Chromium and WebKit)
context: Tasks 1-37 are done: CLI init and admin:bootstrap (prints « Lien : » and « Code : »), all access, onboarding, profile and privacy screens with stable testids (Interfaces §6), the precached build and custom SW (T35/T36) and, in production builds, T37's bootServiceWorker and installPersistOnOnboarding. No Playwright harness exists; the root test:e2e script already delegates to the web package (T1) and vitest's web project excludes e2e/**.
rulings:
- Spec is the binding authority over the brief. Straight apostrophe ' in every UI string the flows type or match. Never use navigator.onLine as truth (the offline spec asserts 'offline' while navigator.onLine === true).
- Owner ruling 2026-10-08 (WCAG 2.1 SC 1.3.4): the manifest no longer locks orientation (823a3a8) and screens must stay usable in landscape — add ONE landscape check, e.g. a key screen at the project device's viewport with width and height swapped keeps its main action visible and clickable without horizontal scrolling. Prefer a step inside an existing spec so the brief's counts hold (4 passed on CI Linux; 2 passed + 2 skipped on Windows); a separate test must report the new counts (T39's « 10 passed » and T40's totals shift too).
- Labels queried with exact: true, as in the brief and confirmed by the T30/T31 reports: « Lien ou code d'invitation », « Suivant », « Pseudo », « Mot de passe », « Confirmation », « J'ai lu la page Confidentialité et règles », « Créer mon compte », « Se connecter », « Ma salle n'est pas dans la liste », « Nom de la salle », « Ville », « Continuer », « Créer la salle », radios « 3 » and « 45 min », « Commencer »; « Prendre du muscle », « Jamais » and « Petite salle de quartier » come from contracts labels. State is read from attributes, never from French text: connection-status data-state, pending-counter / rejected-counter data-count, offline-ready data-state 'ready', onboarding-step data-step.
- [décision plan] (T39 brief, applies to every spec): no page.route or context.route; faults go through the proxy (setFault, stop, restart), identical under Chromium and WebKit with or without SW. Offline = context.setOffline(true) AND a blackhole (01 §9.1.6: rely on the 4 s SYNC_TIMEOUT_MS, not on a DNS error).
- playwright.config verbatim: testDir './e2e', globalSetup, workers 1, fullyParallel false, timeout 120_000, expect.timeout 10_000, retries CI ? 1 : 0, use { serviceWorkers: 'allow', locale: 'fr-FR', timezoneId: 'Europe/Paris', trace: 'retain-on-failure' }, projects chromium (Pixel 7) and webkit (iPhone 14).
- global-setup: Vite JS API build into apps/web/dist with VITE_OWNER_FIRST_NAME='Alex' (the invite page must show 'hébergé chez Alex'), using the same config loader as the web build script (vite build --configLoader runner, T35-F15); creates .e2e-data/ (gitignored, like test-results/ and playwright-report/). The server fixture calls close() after each test; any console message containing « Content Security Policy » fails the test (P-LOG-4).
- startE2EServer per brief: two free ports; dataDir <REPO_ROOT>/.e2e-data/<stamp>-<random> with .appsport-volume; env APP_ORIGIN=http://localhost:<proxyPort>, PORT=<backendPort>, HOST=127.0.0.1, APPSPORT_DATA_DIR, APPSPORT_PUBLIC_DIR (opts.publicDir ?? DEFAULT_PUBLIC_DIR), APPSPORT_CONTENT_DIR=<REPO_ROOT>/data, APP_VERSION=e2e; cli(['init']) then node --import tsx src/main.ts (cwd apps/server); health within 30 s. node:http proxy relaying everything (Host, Origin, Cookie): blackhole holds the request open, status answers the given JSON for a path prefix, backend down → 502, setFault(null) destroys held sockets; stop() stops the backend only (proxy kept, dataDir kept); restart(env) merges env ('' deletes a key) on the same URL; close() stops both. The browser always uses server.url (localhost), never 127.0.0.1.
- bootstrapAdmin passes --birth-date (default '1990-01-01'), reads the « Lien : » and « Code : » lines, non-zero exit → error carrying stderr. Reports and pasted logs never contain codes or links with a # fragment (implementer-common.md, T31-F23): mask them.
- Review Focus 5: cookie 'dev-session' { httpOnly: true, secure: false, sameSite: 'Lax', path: '/' } and no '__Host-session'; same-origin fetch PATCH /api/me → 200; page.request with Origin http://evil.example → 403 { error: 'origin_mismatch' }. Legitimate page.request calls (e.g. the member invitation through POST /api/admin/invitations) must send Origin = server.url and a JSON body (CSRF rules of the global constraints).
- R-INV-5: the member code is typed in lowercase with spaces. idbVersion reads db.version (Dexie stores LOCAL_DB_VERSION * 10); Dexie DB 'appsport', stores meta (key), outbox, deadletter, user, …; fakeOutboxOp(userId, n) builds a sync_rejection patch { dismissedAt: '2026-10-06T10:00:00.000Z' } valid for SyncOp (T39 relies on it).
- E2E_PASSWORD 'cheval agrafe batterie correcte' (31 code points, >= 14) keeps the admin out of the forced password change (R-MDP-1); if a flow ever lands there, that screen offers only the change form and « Se déconnecter » (owner ruling 2026-10-08).
- R-TST-1: requireServiceWorker throws in CI (process.env.CI) when 'serviceWorker' in navigator is false, otherwise test.skip with « WebKit sous Windows : la CI Linux fait foi ». Local run: pnpm --filter @appsport/web exec playwright install chromium webkit, then pnpm --filter @appsport/web test:e2e arrival offline (no -- with pnpm 10) → 2 passed, 2 skipped on Windows. CI job e2e (blocking: ubuntu-latest, 30 min, pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, playwright install --with-deps chromium webkit, test:e2e, playwright-report and test-results uploaded on failure) → 4 passed. Report both.
- OWNER RULING (2026-10-08), ADR 0001 decision 7 confirmed: a full close of the app counts as consent to activate a newer waiting build; while any app window is open nothing activates without the « Mettre à jour » click; an older-schema build never reaches waiting (decision 5).
- Reports never contain codes, links with a fragment, passwords or tokens.
risks: (a) Proxy fidelity: Host, Origin or Cookie rewritten or dropped (origin_mismatch, lost session), held blackhole sockets not destroyed by setFault(null), restart() resolving before health answers through the proxy. (b) Flaky timing: fixed sleeps instead of expect.poll / toHaveAttribute with timeouts; the 5 s offline budget measured from the attachment of connection-status; triggerForeground must dispatch the visibilitychange the engine actually listens to. (c) emulateStandalone must apply before any app script runs (addInitScript: matchMedia('(display-mode: standalone)') true and navigator.standalone = true), otherwise isStandalone() stays false and persistGranted is never written. (d) The account checkbox label contains a link to the privacy page: check it by role (getByRole('checkbox', …).check()); clicking the label text may navigate away. (e) Leftover backend processes or ports on Windows (tsx child tree not killed by close()), .e2e-data growing without bound. (f) A WebKit SW gap silently skipped in CI instead of failing (R-TST-1).
parallelOk: Can run alongside T41 and T42, but T38 and T41 both add a ci.yml job and dev deps (pnpm-lock.yaml): expect a merge, then re-run pnpm install. Not alongside T37 (consumes it) nor T39/T40 (they consume its harness).

title: E2E: update A to B, kill switch and 426
context: T38 delivered the Playwright harness (proxy-backed E2EServer with setFault, stop and restart; fixtures; pwa.ts helpers; flows; global-setup building apps/web/dist) and the arrival and offline specs; T37 the prompt-mode banner, page kill switch and 426 handling; T36 the cache-first SW and the SW-side kill switch. This task builds two shells A and B and covers 01 §9.1.6 scenarios 4 to 6.
rulings:
- Spec is the binding authority over the brief. [décision plan] no page.route or context.route in any spec: every fault goes through the proxy (setFault), identical under Chromium and WebKit, with or without SW.
- buildTwice: A then B with Vite's JS API (VITE_OWNER_FIRST_NAME='Alex', same config loader as the web build script), build.outDir BUILD_DIRS[L] = <REPO_ROOT>/.e2e-data/builds/{A,B}, emptyOutDir true, plus a test plugin whose transformIndexHtml adds <meta name="e2e-build" content="<L>"> — the ONLY difference between A and B; readBuildHash reads the first line of sw.js; builds.json written; throws if the two buildHash are equal. loadBuilds without builds.json → « lancer la suite via playwright test : global-setup construit A et B ». global-setup keeps T38's build, then awaits buildTwice().
- Ordering exactly as written: setFault on the push (503) or on '/api/sync/' (426) FIRST, then enqueue fakeOutboxOp — otherwise the engine pushes the op before the fault.
- update.spec (serverOptions.publicDir = BUILD_DIRS.A): shell A while B waits, after a reload online and after setOffline(true) + reload (Review Focus 5); update-banner absent at 0 s and at 3 s while meta.activeSessionId is set (R-PWA-3); once cleared and reloaded: visible with data-dismissible 'true'; « Mettre à jour » → shellLabel 'B' and swStatus.buildHash = b within 20 s; the op is still in the outbox (R-VER-4); idbVersion = LOCAL_DB_VERSION * 10 and meta.userId unchanged (R-PWA-4; same schema in A and B, R-VER-5 belongs to T25); shell-* caches = ['shell-<b.buildHash>'] (assert on shell-* only: illustrations-v1 and the 'appsport-meta' marker of ADR decision 5 stay); no banner afterwards.
- protocol.spec: 426 { error: 'protocol_unsupported', serverProtocol: 1, minProtocol: 1 } on '/api/sync/' → connection-status data-state 'protocol_unsupported', op kept (R-VER-2); after restart to B and triggerForeground, banner within 30 s with data-dismissible 'false' and no « Plus tard » (R-PWA-5); « Mettre à jour » → shellLabel 'B'; setFault(null) + triggerForeground → 'online', outbox empty within 15 s, pending-counter data-count '0', rejected-counter data-count = deadletter size (the fake op is rejected by the server).
- kill-switch.spec: caches hold illustrations-v1 and shell-<12 hex>; restart({ SW_KILL_SWITCH: '1' }) + reload → registrationCount 0, no shell-* nor illustrations-* cache within 15 s, page displayed, no extra reload over 3 s (no loop); op and meta.userId intact (IndexedDB never touched, R-PWA-6); restart({ SW_KILL_SWITCH: '' }) + reload → one registration and a controller.
- Expected: pnpm --filter @appsport/web test:e2e → 10 passed on CI Linux (5 specs × 2 projects, plus any separate landscape test T38 added); on Windows the SW-dependent WebKit specs are skipped by requireServiceWorker (report the exact local counts and say the CI job e2e is authoritative); pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck. Reports never contain invitation codes or links with a fragment.
- OWNER RULING (2026-10-08), ADR 0001 decision 7 confirmed: a full close of the app counts as consent to activate a newer waiting build; while any app window is open nothing activates without the « Mettre à jour » click; an older-schema build never reaches waiting (decision 5).
- Reports never contain codes, links with a fragment, passwords or tokens.
risks: (a) ADR 0001 decision 7 (still [à confirmer par le propriétaire]): the browser activates a waiting SW once every client is closed — closing the last page or context between steps activates B without a click and makes the « A while B waits » assertions meaningless; keep one page open from B's install to the click. (b) Vacuous waits: checking « banner absent » before waitForWaitingWorker, or starting the 3 s no-reload window before the cleanup finished. (c) Kill-switch double reload or loop: T36's SW-side navigate plus T37's page reload, or the page registering again because its probe saw a proxy 502 while restart() was in progress. (d) A and B differing by more than the meta tag (non-deterministic build) or equal hashes; three builds in global-setup must fit the 30 min CI job. (e) idbGetAll on the wrong store names (outbox, deadletter, meta) returning empty arrays that make « outbox empty » pass vacuously.
parallelOk: Can run alongside T40 (T40 only adds e2e/epoch.spec.ts on the web side plus server ops files: disjoint from builds.ts, global-setup and these specs) and T41-T43; two E2E suites on one machine need separate worktrees (free ports, own .e2e-data). Not alongside T38.

title: snapshots, restore with a new epoch, and epoch E2E
context: The server is complete through T24: rotateServerEpoch (T22, deliberately left unwired until this restore), privacy:collect / privacy:reapply (T24), dumpDatabase (T20), runCli with COMMANDS and assertStartupPreconditions (T7); T38's harness provides startE2EServer with stop, restart and cli, and bootstrapAdmin. This task adds takeSnapshot / pruneSnapshots / restoreSnapshot with the snapshot and restore CLI, and the epoch-change E2E (01 §9.1.6 scenario 7).
rulings:
- Spec is the binding authority over the brief. Rules: R-DEP-7, R-SYN-25, R-SYN-26, R-SYN-28, R-OPS-10, R-OPS-16, 08 §7, §12 P4 (a), 03 §7, §8, §17 n°10. CLI lines in French, verbatim: stdout « Instantané écrit : <chemin absolu> »; « Base remplacée conservée 30 jours dans <dossier>. », « Restauration terminée. Nouvelle époque : <uuid> (epoch_base_rev <n>). », « Lancez maintenant privacy:reapply, avant de redémarrer le service. »; stderr with exit 1: « Étiquette invalide « <tag> » : attendu daily ou pre-vX.Y.Z. », « Instantané introuvable : <chemin>. », « Instantané corrompu (PRAGMA integrity_check) : base actuelle laissée intacte. », « Volume de données absent : sentinelle <chemin> introuvable. ».
- SNAPSHOT_TAG_RE = /^(daily|pre-v\d+\.\d+\.\d+)$/; invalid → SnapshotError('invalid_tag') and no file. daily uses the Paris civil date (parisDate): '2026-10-06T22:30:00.000Z' → daily-20261007.db. takeSnapshot: mkdir snapshots, remove a stale .partial, node:sqlite backup(sqlite, partial, { rate: 0x7fffffff }) in one step, PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE on the copy, renameSync to the final name (same name replaces); no -wal or .partial left.
- pruneSnapshots(dataDir, now, { keep = 3, maxAgeDays = 30 }): first delete every daily-*.db, pre-*.db and replaced-* directory whose mtime is older than 30 days (03 §7, R-OPS-10: nothing older than 30 days, even among the last 3), then keep the 3 newest per prefix (mtimeMs then name, descending); other files untouched. The snapshot CLI prunes after writing.
- restoreSnapshot order imposed (Review Focus 4): 1 snapshot exists else RestoreError('snapshot_missing'); 2 integrity_check on the snapshot opened read-only, exception or not [{ integrity_check: 'ok' }] → 'integrity_failed'; 3 copy to appsport.db.restoring; 4 open it, rotateServerEpoch(db, { ids, clock }) (epoch_base_rev = sync_counter, epoch_started_at = restore time, R-SYN-25), journal_mode=DELETE, close — any error removes .restoring and rethrows; 5 move appsport.db, -wal and -shm into snapshots/replaced-<AAAAMMJJTHHMMSSZ from clock>/ (R-OPS-16; replacedDir, else null); 6 rename .restoring → appsport.db. The live DB stays byte-identical (sha256) on every failure path.
- snapshot requires sentinel and DB; restore requires only the sentinel (P4 (b) on a fresh machine; no current DB → exit 0 and no replaced-*). restore uses cryptoIds(), systemClock and path.resolve; snapshot uses systemClock.
- restore-privacy (Review Focus 4, 03 §17 n°10): after restoreSnapshot then reapplyPrivacyEvents on a new context of the same file, alice's old cookie → 410 { error: 'account_deleted' }, alice absent from user, isHealthConsentActive(bob) false, bob's limitations deleted and empty, dumpDatabase without 'TEMOIN-C2-genou'. T24 ruling stands: a consent withdrawn then re-granted after the snapshot is withdrawn again (fail-closed).
- epoch.spec (Chromium and WebKit, 180 s), through T38's harness only (no page.route): admin created by API (bootstrapAdmin, accept, profile, home place, complete; no health consent); snapshot --tag daily; PATCH daysPerWeek 4; privacy:collect, stop, restore, privacy:reapply, restart; then epoch2 ≠ epoch1, meta.serverEpoch epoch2, watermark '<epoch2>:…', mirror daysPerWeek back to 3 (R-SYN-28: the server wins), no …/consents/health/replay-withdraw request (T26), pending-counter data-count '0', outbox empty, no 401 nor 410 response, one pull without since (full pull).
- Windows: close every DatabaseSync / Kysely handle (and the test context) before restoreSnapshot — renaming or moving an open SQLite file fails on Windows while it passes on Linux. Expected: pnpm --filter @appsport/server test ops/ → Test Files 4 passed; pnpm --filter @appsport/web test:e2e epoch → 2 passed. Reports never contain invitation codes or links with a fragment.
- Reports never contain codes, links with a fragment, passwords or tokens.
risks: (a) The concurrent-writes snapshot test passing vacuously or flaking: it must prove at least one insert landed between the backup start and its resolution, with count(pair_a) = count(pair_b) ≥ 20 000 and integrity ok, within 60 s. (b) Restore failure paths leaving .restoring or replaced-* behind or touching the live DB; the epoch rotated in the live DB instead of the copy; the foreign WAL ('apres-instantane') replayed into the restored base instead of moving away with the old -wal/-shm. (c) Prune grouping or ordering by name instead of mtime (pre-v1.9.0 vs pre-v1.10.0), deleting non-matching files (notes.txt) or recent replaced-* dirs. (d) Dates: UTC instead of the Paris date for daily names, replaced-<stamp> not taken from the injected clock. (e) CLI: snapshot accepted without sentinel or DB or without --tag, the last three restore lines out of order (lines.at(-3) to at(-1)), Windows path separators not covered by [\\/] in the regexes. (f) epoch.spec: a replay-withdraw sent, or an incremental pull instead of a full one after the epoch change.
parallelOk: Its server half (apps/server/src/ops, cli.ts, test/ops) is independent of T37-T39; only epoch.spec needs T38's harness. Can run alongside T39 (disjoint files) and T41/T42. Not alongside T43/T44 (they edit cli.ts and consume snapshot/restore).

title: server bundle, Dockerfile, compose and image contract
context: The server runs under tsx in dev and E2E; the web build (T35) writes apps/web/dist; static serving reads APPSPORT_PUBLIC_DIR and the catalog APPSPORT_CONTENT_DIR (T23); /api/health returns { status, version, db, protocol, minProtocol, epoch, swKill } (T6); runtime dependencies are pure JS plus node:sqlite (better-sqlite3 is test-only, T3 ruling). No bundle, Dockerfile, compose file or image job exists yet; ci.yml has lint, typecheck, typecheck-ts6 and test jobs (plus e2e once T38 is merged).
rulings:
- Spec is the binding authority over the brief. Rules: 01 §2-§3, R-DEP-2, R-DEP-5, R-OPS-3, R-TST-1, 08 §4 compose and contract 1-7, §13.1.
- build.mjs exactly as the brief: esbuild entryPoints ['src/main.ts'], bundle, platform 'node', format 'esm', target 'node24', outfile 'dist/server.mjs', the createRequire banner, legalComments 'eof', no .txt loader (the common-password list is a TS module, T8). dist/server.mjs is one ESM file with no import outside node:* (bundle.test regex). Scripts: apps/server build = "node build.mjs"; root build:server; root build = web then server. Dev deps: esbuild (same ^0.28 line as apps/web) and yaml 2.x (T42's test reuses it).
- bundle.test: server.mjs copied into a temp dir OUTSIDE the repo (no node_modules) with data/.appsport-volume, public/index.html and a copy of the repo's data/; node server.mjs init → 0 and data/appsport.db created; db:check → 0; launched server → /api/health { status: 'ok', version: 'v9.9.9-test', db: 'ok', protocol: 1, minProtocol: 1, swKill: false }.
